scope: Completed five-seed primary validation snapshot; no test evaluation; no model or prepared-profile loads in compacting this report.

gaussian_copula.purpose: Primary comparator using the same target marginal knots as calibration.

independent_marginals.purpose: Same target marginal knots as calibration, with independent latent coordinates.

exact_marginal_copula.purpose: Secondary reference retaining every sorted training observation.

physical.aggregation: Arithmetic mean over 64 condition-specific metrics. Diversity near 1 is descriptive; lower W1 is better.

control_replay.interpretation: Identical controls are reported once; repeated reports do not supply independent seed replications.

primary_ramp_signal.interpretation: The relative ramp signal is met, but the required absolute ramp gate is not met by the five-seed primary mean.

task.name: within_day_observed_history_next_interval_linear_ridge
task.macro_definition: Arithmetic mean of per-condition RMSE/MAE; each condition has equal weight.

utility.aggregation: Arithmetic mean of per-condition RMSE or MAE across 64 conditions, not RMSE pooled across conditions.
utility.interpretation: Point-estimate RMSE tolerance only; MAE ratios are descriptive. No utility intervals are supplied by the physical bootstrap. This is not a formal noninferiority or broad forecasting claim.

paired_physical_interval_protocol.coverage_interpretation: Descriptive marginal percentile intervals; nominal coverage is not guaranteed, particularly near coincident CDFs where W1 is nonsmooth. Not a significance claim.
paired_physical_interval_protocol.uncertainty_scope: real-meter sampling conditional on frozen models and reference arrays; excludes training-seed, generated-sample, comparator-sample, preprocessing-fit, model-selection, and future-period uncertainty

paired_interval_sign_counts.interpretation: Descriptive counts of individual interval positions; not pooled significance, joint coverage, or a multiplicity-adjusted test.

hash_list_scope: Distinct declared SHA-256 values for source code, artifacts, prepared input files, frozen evaluation arrays and grouping identities. Per-meter identity fingerprints and alias/curation identity lists are excluded; their complete audit remains bound by metadata/manifest hashes in the full report.
qualifications: Artifact bindings and curation metadata are checked; this collector does not perform identity auditing. Exact-trace curation does not prove household independence or exclude near-duplicates.

Calibration directly targets training marginals and marginal diversity, with finite-reference approximation; improvements in these diagnostics are not independent joint evidence. Validation was used for development and checkpoint selection; unseen-test performance remains unknown.
All intervals are conditional on frozen samples and models; do not average their endpoints or treat five deterministic control repeats as independent observations.
No claim that conditional resampling is beaten: all five daily, peak, ramp and lag-one ACF intervals against it lie above zero.
The primary mean ramp W1 exceeds 0.10 kW; only seed 22 meets all four descriptive absolute gates. No seed or evaluation cap is selected to reverse this result.
Utility RMSE is slightly higher than both real-trained and resampling-trained references in all five seeds, although within the descriptive 10% tolerance.
Validation served development and checkpoint selection. Exact-trace curation is not proof of independent households; unseen-test performance remains unknown.
